provenance: All five are prefill-house readings of the frozen production profile (prefill250, pp2048, -b 5632) that were recorded with launch=worst=NOMINAL and are already in the tree: 276.25 and 300.43 are quoted in scripts/check/prod_profile.py's docstring; 292.34 is the 2026-09-18 referenceable prefill; 281.51 is Backup/prod_profile/prod_profile_20260920_1528.json (PASS, NOMINAL/NOMINAL); 275.65 is the same tool on 15:50 (refused only because the run left NOMINAL).
note: REFERENCE FROM RECORDS, not from a fresh recording on a certified-healthy box. Refresh with --record --this-box-is-healthy when the box is known good. The healthy span is 275.65-300.43 (1.09x); the 0.85 floor (239.3) sits 13% below the worst healthy sample, and the degraded window measured on 2026-09-20 18:1x read about 0.2x of the median -- so the line is not a knife edge.

unclean_samples.why_unclean: another line's llama-server was loaded on the box at the time (its mtp_accept_ab L3-dose arm1). NOT folded into the median: the band is meant to be the solo-box population, and 274.14 was measured while sharing. Kept because it is the one live sample this tool has produced, and because it says something real: the sentinel reads HEALTHY even on a shared box -- so it does NOT prove exclusivity, only physical speed. Exclusivity still comes from the pgrep gate.
